standard-dialogue.npc: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!

steps.npc: Huh! I'm Razvan, ravaging after food is what I mostly do...occasionally I'll happen across a rat...and that's a good day...just like today!

options.text: How do you like your town?

steps.player: How do you like your town?

steps.npc: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help out?

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help out?

steps.npc: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.

after-the-blood-moon-rises.npc: Hey, it's the hero! Thank you so much for everything you've done, not just for us, but for all of Morytania!

steps.npc: Huh? I'm Razvan. Ravaging after food is what I mostly do. Ocasionally I'll happen across a rat, and that's a good day, just like today!
Well, I'd be lying if I said life was suddenly perfect, but it's nice to no longer live in constant fear of the vampyres.

steps.player: What will you do now that you don't have to worry about them?

steps.npc: Well, quite a few of us are working on making the town a bit nicer. Not that there's anything wrong with the work you did of course.
Some of the others don't want to stick around. They reckon it might be safe enough to make the journey up to Paterdomus now. I think they want to start a new life across the Salve.

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help out?

steps.npc: With the town? No, I don't think so. You've done enough to help us anyway.
I suppose if you did want to help in some way though, you could maybe assist those who want to get to Paterdomus. The swamps can still be pretty dangerous.
